coverage.row: Acceptance 1: project files/search/edit/shell preserve readonly, allowlist and root policy; missing capabilities are omitted and named
Acceptance 2: provider failure retains completed write/results; continuation executes only next command
Acceptance 3: cooperative/forced Stop settles active and skipped calls, preserves uncertainty, permits next command
Acceptance 4: real headerless React edit/build/preview/exit/syntax-error/repair/render cycle with host capability changes and loud resident admission
Acceptance 5: stopResident preserves acknowledged files, clears replay and shares restart overlap rejection; restart keeps replay until exit
Acceptance 6: packed public imports execute shared cycle on existing fixed Vite snapshot with zero runtime registry acquisition
Parity 1: native command completion/output/Worker/effects and invocation cwd/env semantics survive adapter
Parity 2: file policy failure retains SDK facts; ordinary transforms do not claim CAS or rollback
Provider torn state after write: retained write/results and explicit provider error
Command cancellation: await cooperative settlement, skipped call error and next command
Worker forced Stop peer loss: physical replacement, unknown effects, no replay
File/shell corrupt policy input: denied write/command leaves protected files unchanged
Host mode sibling drift: new tools/prompt; stale project operations fail at owner
Replacement torn state/overlap: same restart owner/report, no competing generation or resident replay
